target: Rural residents and parents in Dhule, Palghar, and Nandurbar districts of Maharashtra, particularly in villages
narrative: A coordinated network of freshly created accounts spread fabricated claims that a gang of 25 child abductors had entered Maharashtra to kidnap children for organ harvesting, alleging five children had already been found dead without kidneys. Posts amplified a shared viral video link and urged immediate mass forwarding, framing strangers described as fake doctors and fake sadhus as suspects, during the COVID-19 lockdown period.

legal_suggestions.why: Posts spread fabricated claims of a child-abduction and organ-harvesting gang designed to cause public fear and alarm in rural Maharashtra communities.
legal_suggestions.title: Statements conducing to public mischief (rumours causing fear or alarm)

legal_suggestions.why: 26 accounts using near-identical templated text, shared URLs, and synchronised posting times indicate a coordinated conspiracy to disseminate the false narrative.
legal_suggestions.title: Criminal conspiracy (coordinated action)

legal_suggestions.why: Posts describing perpetrators as 'fake sadhus' and 'fake doctors' entering from the border carry implicit characterisation that could promote enmity or suspicion toward identifiable outsider groups within the community.
legal_suggestions.title: Promoting enmity between groups
